title: [openconnect] crashes inside libopenconnect: ctx->form->opts->_value not set
line: Cancelling a GlobalProtect single sign-on login no longer crashes kded.
explanation: When an openconnect VPN needs a web (SSO) login, plasma-nm shows it in the auth dialog and libopenconnect waits on a callback. That callback returned success no matter how the login ended, so after Cancel libopenconnect's GlobalProtect code went on to read the username from a form that was never filled and crashed on strdup(NULL), taking kded down. The callback now returns the cancelled result when the user quit, and the dialog sets its quit flag before waking the worker so the check is reliable.

commits.message:
openconnect: report a cancelled web login as cancelled

The web login callback always reported success, even when the dialog
was cancelled, so libopenconnect went on with an empty form and kded
crashed; it now returns a cancelled result, and the flag is set first.

BUG: 486076

media.caption: Before: Connect opens the SSO page, Cancel makes kded6 crash (it restarts; the tray icons reload)
After: same steps, the dialog closes and kded6 keeps running
Before: SSO login page from the fake GlobalProtect portal
Before: after Cancel kded6 crashed (KCrash in the journal, new kded6 process, duplicated Bluetooth tray icon while it reloads)
After: after Cancel the dialog is gone and kded6 is the same process

review.text: Clean, targeted crash fix in plasma-nm's OpenConnect auth helper. Moving d->userQuit = true before releasing waitForWebEngineFinish establishes happens-before visibility across the semaphore, and returning OC_FORM_RESULT_CANCELLED from openWebEngineP() prevents libopenconnect from proceeding with an empty form and crashing kded6. Verification against a fake GlobalProtect SAML portal clearly demonstrates both the kded6 crash before and clean cancellation after.

reviews.text: Clean, targeted crash fix in plasma-nm's OpenConnect auth helper. Moving d->userQuit = true before releasing waitForWebEngineFinish establishes happens-before visibility across the semaphore, and returning OC_FORM_RESULT_CANCELLED from openWebEngineP() prevents libopenconnect from proceeding with an empty form and crashing kded6. Verification against a fake GlobalProtect SAML portal clearly demonstrates both the kded6 crash before and clean cancellation after.

Implements exactly the cause mss identified in c10: openWebEngineP() returned success after a cancelled web login, so gpst_login strdup'd a NULL form value; it now returns OC_FORM_RESULT_CANCELLED like processAuthFormP() does. Moving userQuit = true before the semaphore release is correct, since the release/acquire pair then orders the plain bool write before the worker's read. The rig repro with a fake GlobalProtect SAML portal matches the reported trace before and shows no KCrash, same kded6 PID and UserCanceled after, including the title-bar close path. Minimal, right repo, commit message accurate.
